ValidationRule.description: Prevents direct editing of Ticket Type on confirmed or cancelled registrations to protect inventory and accounting integrity.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Ticket_Type__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Registration_Status__c, "Confirmed"), ISPICKVAL(Registration_Status__c, "Cancelled") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Ticket Type cannot be changed directly on a confirmed or cancelled registration. Please cancel and re-book or use the Ticket Upgrade process.
